Food Safety Guidelines for Storing Leftovers

Handling and Storage:
- Refrigerate leftovers within two hours of cooking to prevent bacterial growth.
- Divide large portions into smaller amounts to speed up the cooling process.
- Store leftovers in shallow containers, which allow heat to dissipate more quickly and evenly.

Cooking and Reheating:
- Reheat all leftovers to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) before serving to ensure food safety.
